buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 1. Bidder need to upload scope of job with duly signed and stamp.

2. Bidder need to upload past experience certificate (work order/WDC) on the on board fitted search lights with similar model. Certificate to upload mandatory. If failed t o upload the certificate the bid may considered as technically disqualified. 3. Presently, the ICGS C-143 is based at Mumbai. However, the base port of the I B is at Vadinar. Accordingly, bidder needs to undertake the defect rectification based on the location of the vessel. 4. Bidder needs to visit the vessel physically/virtually/telephonically for better ass essment scope of job and obtain the undertaking certificate from the unit (ICGS C-143) and same to be uploaded in GeM portal while submission of bids. If failed to upload the certificate the bid may considered as technically disqualified. 5. Replacement of defective spares (if any) and fabrication of gear trains under bi dder scope. 6. Subletting of contract, either wholly or partially, shall not be permitted. If observed, the contract will terminate at any time. 7 . Non-blacklisting declaration. The bidder to submit a self-declaration that the fir m has not been blacklisted, debarred or suspended by the GeM admin and government orga nisation as on the date of submission of the bid. Failed in submission of said declaration certi ficate during participation will liable to be technically disqualified. 8. Submission of Acceptance certificate: The bidders are to submit following certi ficate on firm’s letter head for favorable consideration of the bids: - I/We have personally seen, confirmed and understood the requisite specifications, quality and quantity of the items as per Coast Guard service requirement and will carried out the work accordingly. Further, we certify that we comply the custom bi d specification and supporting documents. Note: If the above-mentioned certificates are not submitted, the bids may be summaril y rejected 3.
